core_mode: M018 兼爱非攻/三表法/科学实证/工匠精神/尚同尚贤
description_zh: 墨子（约前468-前376年），战国初期思想家，墨家学派创始人。名翟，宋国人（一说鲁国人）。出身工匠阶层，早年习儒，后批判儒家繁礼厚葬，创立墨学。核心思想为兼爱（无差别地爱所有人）、非攻（反对不义战争），主张尚贤（任人唯贤）、尚同（统一是非标准）、三表法（经验、效用、历史三重验证）、节用、节葬、非乐、非命等十大主张。在科学领域，墨家是先秦逻辑学重要开拓者，提出光学八条等科学成就。《墨子》全书共53篇，大部分为墨翟弟子或再传弟子记述其言行的集录。
description_en: Mozi (c. 468-376 BCE), early Warring States thinker and founder of Mohist school. Named Di, from Song state (or Lu). Born into artisan class, studied early Confucianism but later criticized its elaborate rituals and thick burials, founding Mohism. Core ideas include universal love (indiscriminate love for all), anti-aggression (opposition to unjust wars), worthiness promotion (appointing based on merit), uniformity, threefold method, frugality, simplified burial, anti-music, and anti-fatalism. In science, Mohism was a pioneering school of pre-Qin logic, proposing eight optical principles. The complete Mozi contains 53 chapters.
reason_zh: 核心思维模式：M018（兼爱非攻/三表法/科学实证/工匠精神/尚同尚贤）。墨子体现了平民思想家的典型特征，出身工匠却具有博大的胸怀和深邃的思想。兼爱突破儒家亲亲之爱的局限；非攻奠定和平主义哲学基础；三表法开创中国古代经验主义认识论；在科学领域，墨家通过实验观察和逻辑推理建立系统科学方法论；尚贤尚同构建平等参与的政治理想。墨子思想体系具有强烈实践性和系统性，止楚攻宋实践和墨家组织严密行动体现知行合一的实干精神。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M018 (Universal Love/Anti-Aggression/Threefold Method/Scientific Empiricism/Craftsmanship Spirit/Uniformity-Meritocracy). Mozi embodies the characteristics of a popular philosopher, born into artisan class yet possessing profound breadth of thought. His universal love broke through Confucian love-of-relatives limitation; anti-aggression established pacifism foundation; threefold method pioneered ancient Chinese empiricist epistemology; Mohism established systematic scientific methodology through experimental observation and logical reasoning; uniformity-meritocracy constructed equal political participation ideals. Mozi's thought system has strong practicality and systematicity, his stopping Chu from attacking Song practice and disciplined Mohist organizations embody unity of knowledge and action.
expected_zh: 建立无差别的博爱社会秩序，消除强凌弱、富侮贫、贵傲贱的社会现象
开创中国古代经验主义认识论，奠定科学方法论基础
在自然科学领域取得重大突破，建立系统的光学、力学、几何学理论
构建以贤能为标准的政治参与机制，打破贵族垄断
实现和平主义的国际关系准则
expected_en: Establish an indiscriminate loving social order, eliminating phenomena of strong bullying weak, rich humiliating poor, noble despising humble
Pioneer ancient Chinese empiricist epistemology, laying foundation for scientific methodology
Achieve major breakthroughs in natural sciences, establishing systematic theories in optics, mechanics, and geometry
Construct political participation mechanisms based on merit, breaking aristocratic monopoly
case_zh: 墨子出身贫寒，早年做木匠，手艺精良可与鲁班比肩；后弃儒创立墨家，提出兼爱非攻十大主张；曾亲赴楚都，以智慧和技艺说服公输盘（鲁班），演示攻城器械的防御能力，成功阻止楚攻宋的战争；在城门防守、器械制作、兵力配置等领域有深入研究和实践；发展出光学八条等科学成就，系统论述光的直线传播、小孔成像、镜面反射等原理；创立严密组织墨者，纪律严明，摩顶放踵以利天下，《墨子》53篇记录了其学说与实践，成为中国古代重要的思想遗产。
case_en: Mozi was born poor, worked as a carpenter in his early years with skills comparable to Lu Ban; later abandoned Confucianism to found Mohism, proposing ten propositions of universal love and anti-aggression; personally traveled to Chu capital, persuaded Gongshu Pan (Lu Ban) with wisdom and skill, demonstrating defensive capabilities of siege weapons, successfully preventing Chu from attacking Song; conducted research in city gate defense, weapon manufacturing, and troop deployment; developed eight optical principles discussing straight-line propagation of light, pinhole imaging, mirror reflection; founded disciplined Mohist organization with strict discipline and members who endured hardship for the benefit of the world; 53 chapters of Mozi recorded his teachings and practices as important ancient Chinese ideological heritage.
steps_zh: Step 1: 兼爱思维法（M018）——通过爱人若爱其身的原则，构建超越血缘、身份、国界的普遍关爱体系，消除强凌弱、富侮贫的社会现象
Step 2: 三表法思维（M018）——以上本之于古者圣王之事、下原察百姓耳目之实、废以为刑政观其中国家百姓人民之利为认知检验标准
Step 3: 科学实证思维（M018）——通过观察实验探究自然规律，建立光学八条、力学原理等科学体系
Step 4: 工匠精神思维（M018）——以工匠技艺类比治国理政，追求精准、实用、可操作的解决方案
Step 5: 尚同尚贤思维（M018）——打破贵族垄断，以贤能为标准选拔人才，建立统一的是非标准
Step 6: 和平实践思维（M018）——通过外交智慧和防御技术，成功阻止不义战争，践行和平理念
steps_en: Step 1: Universal Love Thinking Method (M018) — through the principle of loving others as yourself, construct a universal care system transcending blood ties, status and national boundaries, eliminating phenomena of strong bullying weak
Step 2: Threefold Method (M018) — verify knowledge through three standards: based on ancient sage kings' deeds, observed through people's senses, and tested by effects on state and people
Step 3: Scientific Empiricism (M018) — explore natural laws through observation and experiments, establishing optical eight principles and mechanical systems
Step 4: Craftsmanship Spirit (M018) — analogize statecraft to artisan skills, pursuing precise, practical and operational solutions
Step 5: Uniformity-Meritocracy (M018) — break aristocratic monopoly, select talents based on merit, establish unified standards of right and wrong
Step 6: Peace Practice (M018) — through diplomatic wisdom and defensive technology, successfully prevent unjust wars
